review: S05 indexed-origin selection security and compatibility

checks.detail: Document-scoped lookup returns one stable indexed-copy locator and all same-document aliases in deterministic completeness, update-time, and alias-ID order; alias rows remain private.

The resolver examines each alias, selects the first validated original, reports deterministic fallback status, and retains the exact indexed_document_unavailable error when the separately validated copy also fails.
The unchanged candidate reader enforces lexical/canonical/hash binding, same-handle identity and post-open checks, symlink-retarget rejection, strict UTF-8, and a 10 MiB bounded read.

The isolated fixture checks two lexical aliases, retargeting, changed content, size limit, permission denial, missing origin/copy, legacy hash-only fallback, redaction, and unchanged ledger rows and file inventory around resolver calls.

The revised legacy oracle checks two distinct alias IDs, both immutable lexical paths, and their common canonical target; it retains both aliases in the later hash-only fixture. Existing HTTP, stdio, bundle, viewer, and eight-tool assertions remain.
